note: Supplementary professional Chinese; no official HSK level claimed. Not a Tsinghua or IEDE endorsed curriculum. The supplied agenda does not specify a year.

groups.title: AI technologies
groups.objective: Explain a model, its input and its output.
groups.project: Design a vocabulary assistant: define input, output, baseline and one failure case.

groups.title: Security, safety & governance
groups.vi: An toàn và quản trị AI
groups.objective: Explain risk, consent and human review.
groups.project: Audit an AI learning tool: describe one privacy risk, one incorrect output and a human review step.

groups.title: Industry applications
groups.vi: Ứng dụng AI trong các ngành
groups.objective: Connect a use case to an industry and a measurable benefit.
groups.project: Choose an industry; describe the user, data, expected benefit, error cost and evaluation metric.

groups.title: Student project review
groups.vi: Đánh giá dự án sinh viên
groups.objective: Present evidence and respond to feedback.
groups.project: Review PanTutor using a baseline, test users, observed errors and a revision plan. Do not invent results.

groups.title: New project development
groups.objective: Turn a problem into a testable prototype.
groups.project: Propose a small prototype with a problem statement, data plan, milestones and acceptance criteria.

groups.title: IEDE collaboration
groups.objective: Discuss roles, shared goals and collaboration.
groups.project: Draft a group collaboration plan: shared objective, responsibilities, deliverables and review dates. IEDE is retained as supplied; its full name is not inferred.

groups.title: Faculty meetings & talks
groups.vi: Gặp giảng viên và thuyết trình
groups.objective: Invite questions and summarize a discussion.
groups.project: Prepare a 60-second Chinese project introduction and three questions for a faculty discussion.

groups.title: Interdisciplinary curriculum
groups.project: Redesign one vocabulary lesson connecting language learning with an industry task and an assessment rubric.

groups.title: Data, sequential decisions & alignment
groups.vi: Dữ liệu, quyết định tuần tự và căn chỉnh AI
groups.objective: Explain data quality, feedback and objective alignment.
groups.project: Compare two lesson-selection policies using simulated evidence. Identify the objective, feedback, trade-off and human override.
